question.purpose: The editable board title; the only large text.

label.purpose: Uppercase deck and group labels in secondary ink.

statement.purpose: One value with its change in a recessed statement.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Popovers and the focus view only.

components.name: Plate
components.description: One chart or table with its title and hover controls.
components.css: .ds-plate { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 14px; } .ds-plate h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 13px/1.4 "Inter Variable", Inter, sans-serif; color: #111827; } .ds-plate.selected { outline: 2px solid #2456e6; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: A bank, measure, or rule in the control deck.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 26px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #dce1e8; border-radius: 4px; background: #f5f7fa; color: #111827; font: 500 12px/1 "Inter Variable", Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: rgb(36 86 230 / 0.10); border-color: #2456e6; color: #2456e6; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2456e6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #dce1e8; border-radius: 4px; background: #f5f7fa; color: #111827; font: 500 12px/1 "Inter Variable", Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #e9edf2; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-pri { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #2456e6; border-radius: 4px; background: #2456e6; color: #ffffff; font: 500 12px/1 "Inter Variable", Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-pri:hover { background: #1d47c4; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; background: #f5f7fa; border: 1px solid #dce1e8; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-seg button { height: 22px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #4b5565; font: 500 12px/1 "Inter Variable", Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #ffffff; color: #111827; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #dce1e8; }

components.name: Statement
components.description: One value, its change, and a sparkline.
components.css: .ds-stmt { background: #f5f7fa; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px 6px; } .ds-stmt .l { font: 500 12px/1.4 "Inter Variable", Inter, sans-serif; color: #4b5565; } .ds-stmt .v { font: 500 20px/1.2 "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #111827; } .ds-stmt small { font-size: 11.5px; color: #157a4a; }

components.name: Table
components.description: Exact values with a sticky header and accent-selected row.
components.css: .ds-table { border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-table th { text-align: right; font: 500 11.5px/1.4 "Inter Variable", Inter, sans-serif; color: #4b5565; padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid #dce1e8; } .ds-table td { height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; text-align: right; border-bottom: 1px solid #ebeef3; font: 12px/1.4 "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-table tr.focus td { background: rgb(36 86 230 / 0.10); } .ds-table tr.focus td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #2456e6; }

components.name: Time Ruler
components.description: The board time axis with an as-of caret and a comparison caret.
components.css: .ds-ruler { position: relative; height: 52px; background: #ffffff; border-top: 1px solid #dce1e8; } .ds-ruler .ax { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 26px; border-top: 2px solid #dce1e8; } .ds-ruler .caret { position: absolute; top: 12px; width: 2px; height: 30px; background: #2456e6; }

components.name: Agent Tile
components.description: The single agent affordance: unsupported, ready, working, done.
components.css: .ds-agent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px 0 9px; border: 1px solid #dce1e8; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #4b5565; font: 500 12px/1 "Inter Variable", Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-agent i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #157a4a; } .ds-agent.working { border-color: #2456e6; } .ds-agent.working i { background: #2456e6; }

narrative.overview: Bankgraph is an instrument, not a publication. A cool neutral work surface carries analytical plates, each holding one chart or table with the controls that appear when you work on it. Plates sit in rows on a twelve-column field; rows differ in shape by analytical job. One accent marks selection, focus, the as-of caret, and the primary action. Color carries data and state; containers stay neutral. Day and night are two versions of the same instrument.
keyCharacteristics: Plates on a work surface, not cards on a page and not hairlines on paper
One type family with hierarchy from weight and size; mono for numerals only
Controls that look like controls, with visible active states
Charts and tables own their plates; method and source live behind Focus
Day and night as designed variants
rules: The One Accent Rule: #2456E6 is the only interaction color.
The Signed Color Rule: favorable and adverse appear only beside a sign.
The Neutral Container Rule: no plate, row, or control is colored by category.
The Row Rule: a row is the unit of composition and its shape follows the analytical job.
The Natural Control Rule: research language on controls; internal role names never at rest.
dos: Let the chart or table dominate its plate.
Say each fact once; method and source belong in Focus.
Keep day and night as designed variants, not inversions.
donts: Border or color containers by category.
Use type below 11 px or gray text to solve layout problems.
Introduce gradients, glows, glass, decorative icons, or KPI tiles.
